text:
maria: Quick question — when a primary model hits capacity we currently re-route to a generic compatible model. Can we discuss a more nuanced "escape hatch" that picks a secondary variant by tenant tier + region and surfaces controls in the console?

dan: +1 we need tier-aware rules. Right now it's too blunt and causes enterprise workloads to get lower-quality substitutes.

sree: Proposal sketch: prefer-substitute header that encodes preference list, then runtime matches on (tenant_tier, region, lat_slo). If primary saturated, pick first compatible in preference list, else fallback to circuit-breaker queue.

jess: Love the header idea. Can we expose a tenant-level override in Console (e.g., "substitution policy") with options: prefer-closest-latency, preserve-quality, cost-saver?

maria: UX note: default should be "preserve-quality" for paid tiers, "cost-saver" for free tier. Console should show historical switch rate and quality delta.

kyle: Telemetry needs: fallback_count, fallback_rate_by_tenant, avg_latency_delta, quality_regressions_by_promptset. Also tag each event with chosen_variant_id and matched_reason (capacity|region|qos).

ops-bot: deploy noted — can we avoid a global rollout until metrics are in? :robot_face:

paul: For API surface, idea: Accept-Variant-Priority: "[gpt-4-compat, gpt-4-q8, gpt-4-small]" or a short token: "pv=1:4,2:2" (variant:weight). Runtime will respect tenant policy and variant capacity.

sree: Implementation detail: prefer-local-compatible first (same region), then tier-priority, then sampling-based demotion (start 5% traffic to candidate variant to measure quality). If load persists, increase demotion.

dan: How do we avoid thundering herd when many tenants demote to same cheaper variant? Need per-variant admission queue + tenant-aware fairness.

kyle: Agree. Admission controls: soft-quotas by tenant-tier and exponential backoff on rate-limited adopters. Metric: queue_time_percentile before demotion.

jess: Console features: per-tenant policy editor, one-click dry-run for policy changes, graph of "projected cost vs quality" when toggling policies. Also flag when a policy would route to a variant with known eval regressions.

maria: Ops concern: audit logs for every substitution decision. We need reasons stored with request id for postmortem. Also a rollback switch at org-level.

paul: Security note: ensure any header-based priority cannot be forged by end users — only accepted when token-scoped or tenant-scoped config allows it.

sree: Rollout plan: phase 0 = telemetry + conservative demotion (1% sampling) visible in Console; phase 1 = tenant opt-in; phase 2 = tier-defaults (paid tiers prefer quality); phase 3 = automatic demotion beyond threshold with circuit-breaker.

dan: Need API contract for "matched_reason" and telemetry fields. Let's draft the proto then iterate.

maria: Action items: 1) Sree to PR runtime sketch + admission queue design (ETA 2 days). 2) Kyle to list metrics + Grafana panels (ETA 3 days). 3) Jess to mock Console policy UX and dry-run (ETA 4 days). 4) Paul to propose API header format + auth constraints (ETA 2 days).

ops-bot: reminder: @sree @kyle @jess @paul meeting scheduled tomorrow 11:00 to sync on this thread.

maria: Thanks everyone — let's keep the default conservative and prioritise safe defaults for enterprise customers.

paul: One more thought: add a "fallback_explain" field in the response for internal logs (not returned to end users) with variant_id, reason, and timestamp. Helps QA and infra debugging.

sree: Noted. Will include in proto.

maria: closing loop — will post links to the PRs and Console mocks in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
